title: Magenta craft taken to Nazi Germany
summary: Robert Salas tells of Magenta craft taken to Nazi Germany, about 1930s-1940s at Nazi Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And that craft may uh you know it's reasonable to see where that craft was taken [sighs and gasps] to Germany to Nazi Germany where studies were done uh with that craft.

you see pictures of Kler stuff, you know, and and Dreslaw, you know, and and pills in, you know, in Czechoslovakia and Poland and um you see this tester ring that's like shaped like, you know, it looks like an acorn or vell or something could be fit in there. You think they were testing maybe the magenta craft?
tellings.difference: Puts the study at the Bell test ring in Czechoslovakia/Poland and frames it as a question, not a claim.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim the Magenta craft was taken to Nazi territory and studied there.

as_told.title: Nazi Bell test ring in Poland possibly testing the Magenta craft

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, talks about the "Magenta craft", an unexplained craft the tellers link to Italy in the 1930s. He says it is reasonable to think the craft was taken to Nazi Germany, where studies were done on it. If true, it would mean Hitler's scientists had their hands on non-human technology.
